title: Waterfall API FAQ
snippet:
Waterfall.io is a B2B data API for go-to-market workflows. Use Waterfall to find people at target accounts, enrich contact and company records, match emails to business profiles, find phone numbers, verify email addresses, and check job changes.
###
​
Who is Waterfall for?
Waterfall serves growth, revenue, and go-to-market teams. GTM engineers build prospecting workflows, revenue operations teams fill gaps in CRM records, and product-led growth teams add business context to signups. Developers can also add contact and company data to GTM tools, recruitment platforms, CRMs, marketing software, and other products.

Waterfall combines 30+ data vendors through one API. Coverage varies by provider, so a contact or field missing from one source may be available from another. We evaluate providers on coverage, accuracy, freshness, and cost, and add or remove them as their performance changes. Your team maintains one integration and one set of agreed Waterfall rates, without managing separate vendor connections and contracts. Changes to the vendor mix do not change those rates. Your total cost depends on the services and options you use and your request volume.

How do I get an API key and pricing?
API access is available by approval. Enter your work email on the [Waterfall website](https://www.waterfall.io/) to request a key, or [book a call](https://www.waterfall.io/book-a-call) to discuss your workflow and pricing. A member of our team reviews every access request; we aim to reply within a couple of hours. We work with a limited number of customers so we can provide direct support and plan capacity around each team’s needs. Once you have a key, send it in the `x-api-key` header. Follow [Authentication](/v1/authentication) and the [Quickstart](/v1/quickstart).

title: Pricing | Waterfall.io
snippet:
How does Waterfall.io pricing work?
Outcome-based, on credits. A credit is deducted only when we return a verified result — a verified email, a matched profile, a mobile number, a confirmed job change. Requests that come back empty are free, and one credit covers the entire waterfall regardless of how many of our 30+ sources we had to query to get the answer. Per-credit rates depend on the endpoints you use and the volume you commit to, and are quoted after a benchmark on a sample of your own records rather than from a list price.

title: Waterfall API introduction
snippet: The Waterfall API is available at `https://api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header. See [Authentication](/v1/authentication).

title: Enrich your first contact
snippet:
1. Set up your API key
You need a Waterfall API key with Contact Enrichment enabled. [Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for access and pricing. Requests use your account’s configured rates. Store the key in an environment variable in your terminal:
```
export WATERFALL_API_KEY="YOUR_API_KEY"
```
Keep the key on your server or in your local environment. See [Authentication](/v1/authentication) for key management.
